editorial:
Imagine living in a small, dusty town where everyone has a dark secret and the local preacher might be the worst person in the room. You follow Arvin Russell, a young man who has had a rough life and just wants to protect his family. The movie feels heavy and gritty, like a slow-burn story where you can tell something bad is about to happen. It connects several different people, from a fake preacher to a corrupt sheriff, showing how their bad choices lead them all toward one big, violent collision. It is not a happy story, but it keeps you hooked because you want to see if Arvin can actually escape the cycle of violence surrounding him.

The acting is top-notch, especially Robert Pattinson who plays a very creepy role. You will love how the plot twists keep you guessing, though some might find the middle part a bit slow. If you like stories about family loyalty and dark secrets, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when Arvin finds out the preacher killed his sister. He lures the preacher into the woods and kills him to get revenge. Later, Arvin faces the corrupt sheriff in a final showdown. After a tense fight, Arvin kills the sheriff too. He ends up surviving the nightmare, finally breaking the cycle of evil that plagued his family for generations and finding a moment of peace.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty crime dramas and stories about revenge.
